facts.fact: Beauclerc 当晚逼妻临摹借来的鹭鸟图赶绣样品。
facts.anchor: getting his wife to copy herons from a book he’d borrowed

facts.fact: 买家嫌弃鹭样粗陋——他早就知道却硬着头皮送上。
facts.anchor: He had known, of course, that they were uncouth and of poor quality.

facts.fact: 活只够几周：机器将停、工人将遣散——工厂倒计时开始。
facts.anchor: they would have to be stilled and the workers sent home

facts.fact: Feld 家 Cassatt 画不见、墙上只剩空白方格；Arielle 撒谎后默认已卖。
facts.anchor: Where there had been the mother and child there was a blank square of wallpaper.

facts.fact: Gilles（将满八岁）与 Eugénie（六岁）登场的孩子们无评判地盯着她吃蛋糕。
facts.anchor: about to be eight, while his sister, Eugénie, was six

facts.fact: Grimard 曾是 Arielle 画室时代的熟人——常来看画、请午餐（圣日耳曼四女性合作画室时代）。
facts.anchor: used to come to the studio in which I painted

facts.fact: Saint-Germain 把 Berthe 房产、Grimard 画室、Arielle 旧画室连成一网。
facts.anchor: Saint-Germain connected the three new people in her life

facts.fact: Beauclerc 回想自己经营过的铸造厂（为巴黎人织袜是浪费才干——排水盖、车轴才是男人活）。
facts.anchor: He thought of the foundry he had run
